WITH filtered_date_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
dw1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_category,
           i_class,
           i_brand,
           i_product_name,
           d_year,
           d_qoy,
           d_moy,
           s_store_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM filtered_date_dim
    JOIN store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
             d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id
    HAVING GROUPING_ID(i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
                       d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id) = 0
)
SELECT i_category,
       i_class,
       i_brand,
       i_product_name,
       d_year,
       d_qoy,
       d_moy,
       s_store_id,
       sumsales,
       rk
FROM (
    SELECT i_category,
           i_class,
           i_brand,
           i_product_name,
           d_year,
           d_qoy,
           d_moy,
           s_store_id,
           sumsales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT i_category,
               i_class,
               i_brand,
               i_product_name,
               d_year,
               d_qoy,
               d_moy,
               s_store_id,
               sumsales
        FROM dw1
        ORDER BY i_category, sumsales DESC
    ) AS pre_sorted
) AS dw2
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
         d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
